item.description:
Laytee 0.15.0
Translation now works both ways.
- Laytee detects which language of your pair the selected text is in. With French → English selected, French text becomes English and English text becomes French. - The translation card and sticky note show the direction actually used. - Photo text recognition reads both languages of the pair. - Ambiguous text keeps your chosen direction. If only one direction is installed, everything translates that way.
Built and signed locally. Not notarized.
